excerpt: Compare Ajman apartment payment plans by total price, cash due at each milestone, handover balance and contract terms.
introduction:
To compare apartment payment plans in Ajman, put the full price and every instalment on the same timeline. A lower booking payment can be useful, but it may leave a larger amount due at handover or later. The relevant question is whether the complete schedule fits your finances and the contract, not which advertisement has the smallest first number.

Use current written offers for the exact units. The example plans below show how payment stages affect the amount due throughout a purchase.
takeaways: Compare identical price components, registration charges and payment dates before judging the first instalment.
Identify the largest future balance and a credible source of funds if a mortgage or resale is not available.
Check registration, payment-account details, handover definitions and delay provisions before signing.

sections.heading: Begin with the full contract price
sections.body:
Request the price for the exact apartment, what is included and whether any discount depends on a payment timetable. Ask whether parking, furniture, service connections or other items are included or separately payable. A percentage is meaningful only when its denominator is clear.

List reservation, contract-signing, construction, handover and post-handover payments. Note the due date or milestone for each and whether the payment is a percentage of the original price or a different amount. Check the sum of the percentages and ask how any additional charges are invoiced.

If two plans have different prices, calculate the amount actually paid under each rather than applying both percentages to the same assumed price. Compare the complete consideration and not only the deposit. Keep agency, registration, lender and moving costs outside the advertised instalments unless the written quote explicitly includes them.

sections.heading: Compare two sample schedules
sections.body:
Assume a price of AED 600,000 for both examples. Plan A requires 20% at booking, 40% during construction and 40% at handover: AED 120,000, AED 240,000 and AED 240,000. Plan B requires 10% at booking, 40% during construction and 50% at handover: AED 60,000, AED 240,000 and AED 300,000. Each totals AED 600,000 before other charges.

Plan B needs AED 60,000 less at booking but AED 60,000 more at handover. It is not necessarily cheaper; it shifts cash to a later date. The chart compares the booking and handover amounts, not the whole cost. The construction payments and any other charges remain due.

These example schedules make it easier to compare the timing of each payment. Actual plans may contain different milestones, post-handover payments, prices, terms and conditions.

sections.heading: Map each payment to a source of funds
sections.body:
Enter the expected dates into a cash-flow calendar alongside existing rent or mortgage payments, school costs and an emergency reserve. If a milestone can be reached earlier than expected, ask how much notice the developer gives and whether your funds would be available. Compare the schedule to reliable income, not only the total amount you expect to earn over several years.

A handover balance funded by a future mortgage is conditional on the bank's approval, valuation, policy and the borrower's circumstances at that time. Ask a lender whether it considers the project and what evidence it needs, but do not treat today's preliminary conversation as a binding future loan offer. Consider a fallback if finance is unavailable.

A plan that continues after handover can improve initial cash flow while adding obligations after the buyer begins using or renting the property. Model the payment even if a tenant has not yet been found. Rent expected from an unsigned future lease should not be treated as guaranteed funding.

sections.heading: Check the triggers and contract consequences
sections.body:
Ask whether instalments are due on fixed dates, a construction milestone, handover notice or another event. Obtain the definitions in the signed agreement and the process for confirming progress. If a date changes, ask how that affects both the payment and the buyer's housing or financing arrangements.

Review cancellation, default, resale and transfer provisions with a qualified adviser before committing. Ask which consents are needed to transfer the unit before completion and whether unpaid instalments or administration charges must first be settled. Do not assume that a reservation payment is refundable in every situation.

Ajman's [real estate development law](https://ajmanre.gov.ae/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/Amiri-Decree-No-2-2020.pdf) describes registration and escrow arrangements for off-plan developments within its scope. Verify the project's current registration and payment-account details with the department and use the instructions confirmed for the transaction.

sections.heading: Include registration and other charges
sections.body:
The [initial-registration service](https://www.ajman.ae/en/servicecatalog/services/3195) describes how a developer registers an initial unit sale and lists separate registration and certificate charges. The [final-registration service](https://www.ajman.ae/en/servicecatalog/services/3197) applies to final registration of a fully paid unit in a completed project and lists its own items. Ask which services apply, who pays each charge and whether the developer's quote already includes it.

Do the same for agent fees, financing, insurance, utilities, service charges and move-in costs. A discount on the advertised price can be outweighed by charges excluded from one offer but included in another. Avoid applying a general land-sale percentage to every apartment; request the authority's quote for the exact unit.

If the unit is for investment, distinguish annual operating expenses from the price-payment schedule. Compare the payment schedule alongside rental income, operating costs and resale evidence.

sections.heading: Build a comparable shortlist
sections.body:
Use the [Ajman area guide](/journal/ajman-property-2026) to identify suitable locations and review the [Aliyas Ajman project collection](/projects?emirate=Ajman). Ask which specific homes are currently available and request the written price and schedule for each. Do not treat an example on this page as a live offer.

[Contact Aliyas](/contact) with your budget, preferred handover period and funding plan. Ask for an itemised comparison and the project documents, then confirm the ownership right, current registration charges and the verified recipient before paying. Keep a copy of every quote so later changes can be compared against the original terms.
